correctness.rationale: Read original RESULT.md blob 6930dad8ae8ef2628e0914bb7ede9576eedeb765 and verify.py. Rotation increments F_{k+1}−F_k=n x_k−b and direct position sum give mean ab/2. The covariance calculation gives V=b²(n²−1)/12 −sum_{i<j ones} (j−i)(n−j+i). Gap-domain strict concavity of pair penalty makes its minimizers gap-simplex vertices, exactly one block of ones, giving upper expression. For the lower side, F_k modulo n advances by a, so each block of N=n/d successive values consists of distinct residues and has variance at least d²(N²−1)/12; total-variance equality forces each d-spaced consecutive range repeated d times. Rotation increments convert this range condition into all cyclic substring-one counts within floor/ceil b*ell/n, equivalently circular balance; the mechanical Christoffel construction attains it. Independent fresh enumeration checked every nonconstant binary word of n=2..10 and both equality criteria without relying on saved VERIFY_OK. This is an all-n proof; code bounds are only tests.

value.rationale: The established circular Parikh mean loses all order information. A sharp second moment quantifies exactly how much circular order can change the observable, detects the canonical homogeneous and clustered necklaces, and exposes a gcd-sensitive finite-length lower obstruction. It is a natural informative invariant, not a mere relabeling of numerical rotation weights.
